seoTitle: Gérard & Fils - Recycling centre runs, house clearance & cleaning after your move
seoDesc: Moving and want to get rid of bulky items? Our team takes care of everything and ensures a clean, careful service.
h1: Waste disposal and bulky item removal service

sections.h: Let us make your move easier

body.p: A move is the ideal opportunity for a big clear-out, keeping only the essentials. It also reduces the volume you have to pack and move, while giving you more space in your new home. Old clothes and knick-knacks, damaged furniture, obsolete electrical appliances: Gérard & Fils rids you of the surplus thanks to its efficient waste disposal and house clearance service. Our team works before and after your move in all Brussels municipalities. Leave the sorting and transport of your bulky items to us so that you can concentrate on the most important aspects of your move.

sections.h: Waste disposal, house clearance and cleaning

body.p: Our professional removers work carefully and methodically to empty all your rooms quickly, from the cellar to the attic and the garage. They take charge of the whole process, from sorting to taking everything to the recycling centre, in compliance with environmental standards. Whether it is cardboard, metal, glass or wood, all your waste is taken to suitable recycling centres.

Do some pieces of furniture or belongings have a certain value, such as antique furniture, but will not find a place in your new home? We can help you have them valued and sell them at the best price.

Finally, our dynamic team cleans your spaces to leave the rooms clean and clear. Whether you are a tenant wishing to return your flat in perfect condition to your landlord, or you have just sold your house, the premises will be ready to welcome their new owners in optimal conditions.

Entrusting the sorting, waste transport, removal of unwanted items and cleaning of the rooms to our team frees you from a heavy burden before your move. You save time and energy and can concentrate on the essential arrangements for your departure. As well as ending up with clean, clear spaces, you will have a more accurate picture of the real volume to be transported to your new home.
Our team is committed to offering you:

ul: careful work carried out with the right equipment
a free, precise quote and attractive rates

body.p: Do you want to quickly get rid of bulky items in your house, flat or offices when you move? Want to get your rental deposit back at the end of your lease? Call us or send us a message via our online form. We will come as soon as possible, in all Brussels municipalities.
